entities.summary: Tikka Khan was a Pakistani military officer who served as the first chief of the army staff from 1972 to 1976. He, along with Yahya Khan and Abdul Hamid Khan, is considered a chief architect of the 1971 Bengali genocide, occurring under his governorship over East Pakistan, for which he is referred to as the Butcher of Bengal in Bangladesh.
